title: Weekly digest of goal runs
description: Once a week, one HTML page sums up every goal run in the project: steps done, steps that failed and were raised to high, time and cost per run, and what is still open. It is written from the plans' marks and .claude/goal-progress.json, so it needs no new tracking.
raw: can we get some weekly summary of what the goals did, cost and what failed
target: Every Monday the digest page is in the project and opens in the browser; it takes under a minute to read and shows where the week's money and time went.

strengths: The data is already there: plans carry step marks and goal-progress.json has status and notes.
Reuses the HTML report style the plugin already has.
weaknesses: Cost per run is not recorded today; it would be an estimate.
opportunities: The same page could compare builder models over time (Sonnet, Haiku, Fireworks).
threats: Claude Code may ship its own usage reports and make this redundant.

risks.text: Cost numbers are wrong and mislead decisions
risks.mitigation: Show cost only where the session reports it; mark estimates.

assumptions.text: One digest a week is the right rhythm
assumptions.test: Run it by hand for two weeks and see if it is read.

dependencies: Plans keep their step marks in the current format.

options: At the end of each goal run
questions.why: A schedule needs the machine on; by hand is the cheapest start.
One project, or every project under ~/Code?
